notes.title: We're excited to announce that Goppy has officially been released! 🎉
notes.notes:
After spending a considerable amount of time in development and a short early access phase, we're proud to present our brand new game to you.
If you have a great time playing Goppy, we would really appreciate it if you could leave a review to help others discover the game.
In the last few days, we've added some new achievements, a cute new sprite for the endgame-creepers, and an improved background texture.
We hope you enjoy playing Goppy as much as we enjoyed creating it!

notes.title: Achievements are Ready!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

here's the previously-announced update featuring Steam achievements, which complete the game.

Along comes a general difficulty adjustment: taking advice from some testers, I have made everything a bit easier. 
After all, 'Goppy' is supposed to be relaxing and satisfying, not competitive and frustrating!

Finally, some bugs got squashed in the process, like a malfunctioning menu shortcut which nobody noticed anyway. Still.

notes.title: Exciting news! 'Endless Mode' just dropped! 🎉
notes.notes:
This update brings you a brand new game mode where you can compete for the top spot on the global leaderboard. The challenge? Pick up as many goodies as possible without taking a hit! 
Difficulty increases over time, and goodies spawn faster the more you eat, so speed is key. 😎

With this update, 'Goppy' takes a significant leap towards completion. As such, we're pleased to announce that the game is scheduled for its full release on January 26th.

Happy gaming, everyone!
